title: Dacy's Nautilus Armor Recipes
description: This data-pack adds recipes to nautilus armor.
body:
This data-pack adds 4 recipes for mob armor, not to be confused with "Dacy's Horse Armor Recipes".

These recipes are useful due to nautilus armor typically only being obtainable via loot chests. This makes it very difficult not only for servers, but single-player aswell. This data-pack makes recipes for nautilus armor, saving lots of time for an otherwise difficult item.
